_meta.note: Inventory of what each privileged-architecture extension contributes (instructions + CSRs). RVA23 names the version-pinned forms (e.g. Ss1p13, Sm1p13); UDB models them as <name> + <version> field. Both are listed in the udb_name field.

extensions.name: Ss1p13
extensions.description: Supervisor-mode privilege architecture: trap entry/exit, interrupt delegation, virtual-memory base CSR (satp), supervisor-mode environment configuration. Foundation that all Ss*/Sh*/Sv* extensions build on. Supersedes Ss1p12.

instructions.name: sret
instructions.summary: Return from supervisor-mode trap (restores PC from sepc, privilege from sstatus.SPP)

instructions.name: sfence.vma
instructions.summary: Supervisor memory-management fence (synchronize page-table updates, flush TLB)

csrs.name: scounteren
csrs.summary: Counter enable: which hpmcounter/cycle/time/instret are accessible from U-mode

csrs.name: sscratch
csrs.summary: Scratch register for trap-handler context save area pointer

csrs.name: sepc
csrs.summary: Supervisor exception program counter (PC at trap)

csrs.name: scause
csrs.summary: Supervisor trap cause (interrupt bit + cause code)

csrs.name: stval
csrs.summary: Supervisor trap value (faulting address / instruction bits)

csrs.name: senvcfg
csrs.summary: Supervisor environment configuration: FIOM, CBIE/CBCFE/CBZE, PMM, ...

csrs.name: satp
csrs.summary: Supervisor address translation & protection (MODE selects Bare/Sv39/Sv48/Sv57; ASID; root PPN)

extensions.name: Sm1p13
extensions.description: Machine-mode privilege architecture: machine-mode trap handling, ISA discovery (misa), interrupt delegation to S-mode, physical-memory protection (PMP), performance counters, environment configuration. Companion to Ss1p13 (paired version 1.13). The Sm extension is implicit in any conformant RISC-V system; Ss1p13 explicitly requires Sm1p13.

spec.chapter: Chapter 3. Machine-Level ISA, Version 1.13 + Chapter 6. Sm Machine Extensions

instructions.name: mret
instructions.summary: Return from machine-mode trap (restores PC from mepc, privilege from mstatus.MPP)

instructions.name: wfi
instructions.summary: Wait for interrupt hint (low-power stall until pending interrupt)

extensions.name: H
extensions.description: Virtualizes the supervisor-level architecture: introduces HS-mode (hypervisor-extended S-mode) and VS/VU guest modes, adds a second stage of address translation (guest physical → supervisor physical) via hgatp + Sv*x4 page-table formats. Required for KVM/RISC-V, pKVM, Android protected VMs. Mandated by RVA23S64 via the Sha umbrella extension.

spec.chapter: Chapter 5. H Extension for Hypervisor Support

instructions.name: hfence.vvma
instructions.summary: Hypervisor fence: invalidate VS-stage TLB entries

instructions.name: hfence.gvma
instructions.summary: Hypervisor fence: invalidate G-stage (guest-physical) TLB entries

instructions.name: hlv.b / hlv.bu
instructions.summary: Hypervisor load byte (signed/unsigned) from VS/VU virtual address (2 insns)

instructions.name: hlvx.hu / hlvx.wu
instructions.summary: Hypervisor load with execute permission check, instruction-fetch semantics (2 insns)

instructions.name: hsv.b / hsv.h / hsv.w / hsv.d
instructions.summary: Hypervisor store byte/half/word/double to VS/VU virtual address (4 insns)

extensions.name: Sv39
extensions.description: Page-based virtual memory with 39-bit virtual addresses, 3-level page tables, 4 KiB / 2 MiB / 1 GiB page sizes. Selected via satp.MODE = 8 (RV64). The de-facto baseline for Linux on RV64. Mandatory in RVA22S64 and RVA23S64.

spec.chapter: §4.4 Sv39: Page-Based 39-bit Virtual-Memory System (within Supervisor chapter)

extensions.adds_note: No new instructions or CSRs of its own. Defines satp.MODE encoding 8 + Sv39 PTE/VA bit layout. Coexists with H-extension G-stage as Sv39x4 (41-bit GPA).

extensions.name: Sv48
extensions.description: 48-bit virtual addresses, 4-level page tables, adds a 512 GiB page size. satp.MODE = 9 (RV64). Optional in RVA23S64.
extensions.adds_note: No new instructions or CSRs. Defines satp.MODE encoding 9 + Sv48 PTE/VA bit layout. Implies Sv39 must also be supported.

extensions.name: Sv57
extensions.description: 57-bit virtual addresses, 5-level page tables, adds a 256 TiB page size. satp.MODE = 10 (RV64). Optional in RVA23S64.
extensions.adds_note: No new instructions or CSRs. Defines satp.MODE encoding 10. Implies Sv48 + Sv39.

extensions.name: Svbare
extensions.description: satp.MODE = 0 (Bare) must be supported: virtual address used as physical without translation. Needed during early boot and for software that does not require paging. Mandatory in RVA23S64.
extensions.adds_note: Pure satp.MODE=0 conformance requirement. No new state.

extensions.name: Svinval
extensions.description: Decomposes sfence.vma/hfence.* into separate invalidation + ordering steps so a batch of TLB invalidations can be coalesced. Mandatory in RVA23S64.

instructions.name: sinval.vma
instructions.summary: Invalidate VA→PA mapping without ordering guarantees

instructions.name: sfence.w.inval
instructions.summary: Order prior writes to page tables before subsequent sinval.vma

instructions.name: sfence.inval.ir
instructions.summary: Order prior sinval.vma before subsequent implicit reference

instructions.name: hinval.vvma
instructions.summary: Hypervisor variant of sinval.vma for VS-stage

extensions.name: Svnapot
extensions.description: Naturally Aligned Power-of-Two contiguous translations: PTE bit 63 marks a set of contiguous PTEs as a single TLB entry covering a larger page. Mandatory in RVA23S64.
extensions.adds_note: PTE bit 63 (N) is repurposed. No new instructions or CSRs.

extensions.name: Svpbmt
extensions.description: Per-page memory attribute override via PTE bits 62:61 (PBMT field): PMA / NC (non-cacheable, idempotent) / IO (non-cacheable, non-idempotent). Mandatory in RVA23S64.
extensions.adds_note: PTE bits 62:61 (PBMT) become writable. No new instructions or CSRs.

extensions.name: Svade
extensions.description: Page-fault exceptions are raised when a page is accessed with the A (Accessed) bit clear, or written with the D (Dirty) bit clear. Hardware does NOT update A/D — software must. Mandatory in RVA23S64 (alternative: Svadu).
extensions.adds_note: Behavioral profile requirement. Mutually exclusive with Svadu (RVA23 mandates Svade).

extensions.name: Svadu
extensions.long_name: Hardware Updating of PTE A/D Bits
extensions.description: Hardware updates the A (Accessed) and D (Dirty) bits in page tables instead of raising a page-fault. Controlled by menvcfg.ADUE / henvcfg.ADUE. Optional in RVA23S64.
extensions.adds_note: Adds menvcfg.ADUE / henvcfg.ADUE bits but no new CSRs. Hardware A/D update behavior.

extensions.name: Svvptc
extensions.description: Transitions from invalid to valid PTEs become visible to subsequent translations without requiring sfence.vma. Eliminates the need for software to fence on lazy page-table population. Optional in RVA23S64.
extensions.adds_note: Hardware ordering guarantee. No new instructions or CSRs.
